source_cold_start: GNSS+IMU final pass seeded by the preceding IMU result
source_final_refresh: position, velocity, seven clock biases, clock drift and attitude from previous IMU pass; optional RPYReset
recompute satellite receiver geometry and observation residuals
apply final residual rejection thresholds: P L1/L5 20/15 m instead of 50/30 m; D 3/3 m/s instead of 20/20 m/s
add zero-velocity priors and height constraints only in final pass; stationary pose between-factors exist in both passes with the source time-gap gate
native_current: Default remains single main IMU solve. Same-binary opt-in refinement worsens exposed MI8 1.1482535404 to 1.1750020780 m, improves exposed A205U 2.0497405522 to 1.9617046208 m. Both initial GNSS/IMU stages are byte-identical. No global or phone-wide promotion.
next_implementation_requirements: explicit opt-in; default and live all40 recipe unchanged
handoff only in-memory states from successful same-run native solve with exact raw epoch identity
preserve all original UTC output keys; output positions are optimized states, never interpolated
recompute receiver-dependent geometry and residual masks with documented source phase thresholds
retain independently validated units, frames and clock policies per phone
no cached MAT positions or reference-height file in inference; relative-height experiment separately documented
source phone position offset applied once at final output, never twice through recycled corrected positions
report per-stage convergence, factor counts and epochs; reject incomplete/nonfinite handoff
paired same-binary control and candidate with fixed raw inputs; score only after native provenance audit
limits: Matched exposed MI8 and A205U routes prove native provenance and exact initial-stage equality, with opposite accuracy effects. The added pass retains native CombinedIMU/noise/prior and first-pass masks. Exact source initflag distinctions, RPYReset and height constraints remain different. This is not a paired pinned taroz execution or official score.

integration_findings.builder_seed_behavior: With use_spp_seed=false the builder can consume ObservationData receiver_position/receiver_clock_bias. The latter is seconds and is explicitly multiplied by c; optimized C7 states are metres and cannot be assigned directly. SPP-enabled rebuilding would discard warm seeds.
integration_findings.existing_p_remasking: native_pseudorange_remasking selects from a stored pool with fixed measurements and sigma before main; not a complete second source pass.
integration_findings.doppler_geometry: Builder computes receiver-only corrected range-rate, not a residual centred at an arbitrary warm velocity. Final residual screening must separately use optimized velocity/drift in consistent coordinates.
integration_findings.attitude_export: FGOResult.epoch_attitude_rpy_rad stores exact GTSAM rotation angles; epoch_attitude_rpy_deg uses display heading convention and must not be recycled as Rot3 angles.
integration_findings.base_correction: Rebuilt P factors require the existing base correction exactly once; reapplying to an already corrected pool would double subtract.
integration_findings.open_work: Connect the initial GNSS-state observation refresh, separate cached residual-center population from final factor admission, then test phase-specific masks. Exact source cold-start equivalence and pinned taroz runtime comparison remain unproven.

handoff_implementation.test_scope: 5 helper, 12 integration, 8 legacy regression and 6 CLI cases passed; matched MI8 and A205U real-data pairs audited and scored.

validation.scope: Two exposed route/phone groups, same-binary pairs with native provenance and exact initial-stage equality; mixed accuracy effects, no official score or phone-wide adoption.

superseded_v1_validation.reason: App source was edited while compilation was in flight; incremental build kept old app object. Missing refinement_base_application_passes counter caused paired audit to fail. Both affected translation units were touched and rebuilt; v2 executable contains the counter and per-row correction guard. Old runs preserved, not promoted.

next_source_stage_experiment.reason: Adding a second pass alone did not improve MI8; isolate source initialization-stage semantics before combining further changes.
next_source_stage_experiment.source_stop_and_height_constraints: Source zero-velocity prior and height constraints apply only in final pass; stationary Pose3 between-factor remains in both passes with strict raw UTC delta < 1500 ms. Native stop-phase opt-in was validated independently; observation-stage integration additionally disables native relative height in the initial pass. External reference-height inputs remain excluded.
next_source_stage_experiment.candidate_scope: Explicit opt-in phase-aware masks and separate zero-velocity/pose stop gating, preserve GNSS-first defaults and keep relative/external-height choices separate.
acceptance: Same frozen binary/raw inputs for paired control and candidate.
Unchanged GNSS stage, all raw keys and base-correction-once proof.
Record initial/final mask and factor counts, finite state and full convergence.
Test first-pass zero-velocity exclusion independently from retained stop-pose factors and time-gap rejection.
Evaluate both exposed MI8 and A205U route groups; do not call these held out.
No promotion based on one route or mixed recipes; native all40 and official evaluation remain separate.

stage_conditional_audit.remaining_source_parity_work: Support and verify the source attitude-reset setting before claiming complete test-recipe parity.
